title: HtmlRuby
responsibility: Renders the native ruby element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlRuby.attributes
inputs.description: Native ruby attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlRuby.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native ruby element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlRuby
outputs.description: The actual native ruby element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
